questions.q: Why did the Most High call Cain to repent (Genesis 4:7)?
choices: Cain knew the Most High required animal sacrifice and did not bring it
Cain had not tilled the ground well
questions.explain: Cain knew the Most High required animal sacrifice, because the sacrificial law was ordained at Genesis 3:21.

questions.q: What does Matthew 23:35 show about Abel?
choices: Abel was a priest of Melchizedek
Abel was a son of Cain
questions.explain: Christ counts righteous Abel with the blood of the prophets; Abel was trying to get Cain to repent.

questions.q: What do Cain's words 'every one that findeth me shall slay me' and his city show?
choices: The angels lived on the earth
There were more people on the earth than Adam's household
questions.explain: That is proof there were more people on the earth than Adam's household; you do not build a city for three people.

questions.q: Who were the first to take multiple wives?
choices: The sons of the wicked, in the line of Cain
questions.explain: Lamech took two wives; it is the sons of the wicked who did it. In the beginning it was one wife.

questions.q: Why did the Most High choose the line of Seth?
choices: In his line men began to call upon the name of the Lord and keep the commandments
questions.explain: Through Seth men began to call upon the name of the Lord, while the line of Cain went on in wickedness.
